title: Plug to Participate in Wolfe Research Utilities, Midstream & Clean Energy Conference
summary: Plug Power will virtually participate in the Wolfe Research Utilities, Midstream & Clean Energy Conference on September 29, 2026.
body_markdown:
Plug Power will virtually participate in the Wolfe Research Utilities, Midstream & Clean Energy Conference on September 29, 2026. Jose Luis Crespo, Chief Executive Officer, will engage with institutional investors to discuss the Company’s strategic priorities, financial outlook, commercial execution, and progress advancing its integrated hydrogen platform.


Additional information on Plug’s investor conference participation can be found in the Investor Resources section of the Company’s website:[HERE](https://www.ir.plugpower.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx)
